sourceNotes.rawContent: Bring a touch of classic sophistication to your jewelry collection with our Exquisite Fan Pendant Necklace. This high-fashion statement piece features a shimmering geometric drop adorned with delicate crystals, perfect for adding instant glamour to any outfit. Designed for trend-focused styling, this necklace is crafted to be a standout accessory in your rotation. To maintain its brilliant golden luster and protect its intricate finish, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it in a dry, safe place after each wear
